### Elderly, but Happy
Author: Augustus Lopes
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/elderly-but-happy
Passage: Genesis 25:8
Points:
- Aging frequently brings illness, dependence, and feelings of loneliness or uselessness.
- Abraham exemplifies how a believer can reach advanced age feeling fulfilled and blessed.
- A lifetime of trusting God's promises prepares believers to navigate the hardships of old age.
- Walking in steady obedience provides a clear conscience and assurance that God will not abandon us.
- Cultivating a daily relationship with God ensures His comforting presence remains near in later years.
